name: Runway
editorial: For Runway, use a storyboard with a beginning and end rather than a collection of attractive single shots. Generate variants for one difficult transition and keep a log of prompts, references, and rejected outputs. Ask whether you can reproduce an approved visual direction after a client requests a small change. Inspect hands, text, and continuity at the final viewing size, not only in a thumbnail. Estimate the credits required to get an acceptable sequence, including experiments. Keep any source footage and permissions separate from the generated clips for later review. Runway is worth evaluating when your work centers on generative video experiments. Start with a concept animatic and a background motion test; these two deliverables expose different constraints, so a single polished demo is a poor buying test. For the first, write down the time spent preparing source material, making the initial cut, and correcting mistakes. For the second, repeat the process with a fresh asset rather than reusing a finished template. This gives you a practical comparison of effort across routine and less predictable work. Pay particular attention to shot iteration, reference control, and output review. Ask a colleague to open the exported result on another device and note any missing captions, clipped audio, font substitution, or awkward pacing. Keep the source file so you can measure how painful a late revision would be. A workflow that feels fast for one person may slow down when another person has to review it. Before paying, check how credits are consumed across drafts and final renders. Read the current checkout and license terms directly on the merchant site, since plan names and entitlements can change. Save a dated screenshot of the offer and renewal conditions, then compare the total cost over the period you will actually use the tool. If you are buying for a team, assign one person to test access, permissions, and export ownership. This evaluation is our editorial method, not a claim that a discount is available today.
refund_policy: Check current merchant terms; not independently verified.
